name: Amaori no Ningyou-hime ~Tozasareta Tobira, Mesu Ningyou no Shikyuu~
original_name: 雨檻の人形姫～閉ざされた扉、牝人形の子宮～
source:
One day she quietly appeared in front of me. 
What I am only allowed to do is to repeat sexual intercourse over and over every day.
I do not know why I am locked up... I am not allowed to ask...
And the next day will come again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，她悄无声息地出现在我面前。
我唯一获准做的，就是日复一日地不断与她性交。
我不知道自己为何被关在这里……也不允许发问……
然后，第二天又会再次到来。
